Additionally, some hot springs have delicate ecosystems that can be disrupted by the chemicals in sunscreen. By not wearing sunscreen, you're helping to preserve the natural environment of the hot spring and ensuring that the water remains clean and safe for everyone to enjoy. So, in this scenario, it seems like you made the right decision by following the signs and not wearing sunscreen.
